newsitem.title: PERU: Pension funds buy most of Southern Peru bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pension funds buy most of Southern Peru bonds.

text.p: Private pension funds bought the largest share, 30 percent, of a $50 million local bond placement by copper miner Southern Peru Ltd, market sources said Wednesday.
They added that individual investors accounted for 20 percent, while the rest went to banks, mutual funds and various private companies.

Southern announced Tuesday the successful placement of the bonds at an average annual rate of 8.25 percent. A total of $150 million bids were received for the bonds, which mature in 2004, the company said in a statement.
"Southern Peru believes this is the largest placement of long-term bonds carried out in Peru," the statement added.
The company plans to use the money raised to pay for the expansion and modernization works at its Cuajone mine and its Ilo foundry in southern Peru.
